sql:
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS export_count,
  MIN(requested_at) AS earliest_requested_at,
  MAX(requested_at) AS latest_requested_at,
  COUNT(completed_at) AS count_with_completed_at,
  COUNT(file_url) AS count_with_file_url,
  ROUND(AVG(row_count) FILTER (WHERE row_count IS NOT NULL), 2) AS avg_row_count
FROM data_exports
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY export_count DESC, status ASC
note: Grouped by the raw status string exactly as stored in data_exports, platform-wide (no tenant filter), so the report will show whichever status values actually exist (e.g. 'completed' vs. 'succeeded' etc.) alongside completed_at/file_url fill rates to tell whether exports are genuinely finishing.
